name: grafana-observability
description: Inspect administrator-approved Grafana evidence for infrastructure, APM, logs, IoT/edge, and business KPIs.

interface.longDescription: Run five administrator-reviewed Grafana capability packs through bounded tools. Grafana and its datasources remain read-only; the plugin accepts aliases, time windows, and opaque references—not credentials, queries, datasource IDs, or URLs. Pack runs retain only plugin-owned local evidence state.
defaultPrompt: Use $setup-grafana-observability to check the fixture profile and available packs.
Use $setup-grafana-observability to explain how to connect a reviewed read-only Grafana profile.
Use $setup-grafana-observability to list supported packs and activation prerequisites.
